scope: PC contracts; never physical-device or driving approval

identity_and_delivery.preserve: Keep all model choices, N16 default, boot-frozen selection, exact per-model package/hash/size and rollback checks.

fov_center_hud_integration.preserve: Stock/65/70/75/80 live wide-only FOV; unchanged narrow input; bounded, gated center correction and HUD message freshness on every model.

hud_and_alerts.preserve: Lane probabilities, steering, correction/wait reason, camera target/distance and curve speeds, C3X/Jetson notices throughout each fresh active condition with no timed expiry, a one-second minimum settled hold and upward exit after the condition clears, immediate driver-attention glyph and alert priority, BSD pulse and existing Q92/FPS choices.

battery_and_ble.preserve: 108 voltage channels, 15 temperatures, progressive heatmaps, trip SOC, zero-speed/P/charging view and per-field TTL; sequential BLE requests and recovery.

resources_and_state.preserve: Full diagnostics OFF, 1Hz HUD resource and inference timing readouts, model-priority HUD, state/reset/finite checks and exact N16-only optimization gates.

power_and_boot.preserve: Jetson USB input-power block, black boot diagnostics, regular W/temperature text and permission-gated Park update/previous-release recovery.

release_checks: Verify the complete official ONNX hash/size, actual metadata/dtypes/slices and full graph; compare patched CPU outputs on changed inputs, recurrence and reset.
Validate the exact published archive alone: both model spec filenames and source commit, server imports, native HUD font initialization and first real render; re-download/hash all public assets.
Run the full control-loop tests: test_pv5_lane_center.py, test_lateral_startup_control.py and test_lateral_readiness.py in the native PC test environment.

Before declaring hardware validation: verify physical Orin TensorRT build/output precision, saved FOV routing, sustained inference/HUD timing, USB/BLE reconnection and EPS/CAN behavior under a controlled procedure.
